Simultaneously, the Indonesia emerging market program is on track for an August 17 launch, but requires final approval discussions and webpage preparation, including removing password protection and incorporating overcapacity data. The knowledge website redesign is progressing, with decisions to incorporate Joseph's design elements and disperse videos by topic, though feedback on his design is still pending. Operational tasks like the Outlook account lockout are resolved, but urgent attention is needed on the report feedback and program approvals to avoid delays.
